newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi Intl to announce resumption of flights.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi Intl to announce resumption of flights.

text.p: Bankrupt Kiwi International Air Lines, which suspended service on October 15, said on Wednesday it would outline its return to scheduled service on October 31.
On Thursday Kiwi also will present to the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Newark, N.J., a financing plan that would allow the carrier to rehire laid-off employees and restart operations.
Kiwi said it expects the court to approve a $5 million debtor-in-possession financing commitment from the Wasatch Group.
Kiwi filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on September 30 under a $40 million debt load.
